scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/http-client build && bun run --cwd apps/server build && bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build
scripts.check: bun run check:fast && bun run test:fixtures && bun run test:integration:compose && bun run build
scripts.check:fast: bun run env:check && bun run env:contract && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.db:migrate: bunx varlock run -- bun run --cwd apps/server db:migrate
scripts.release:check: bun run release:version-check && bun run --cwd packages/http-client build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun test packages/http-client/test && bun test packages/cli/test && npm --workspace @tmterminal/http-client pack --dry-run && npm --workspace @tmterminal/cli pack --dry-run
scripts.source:repair: bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T worker bun run --cwd apps/server source:repair
scripts.test: VARLOCK_ENV=test bun test apps/server/test/unit packages/http-client/test packages/cli/test scripts/dev-contract.test.ts && VARLOCK_ENV=test bun test apps/web/test && ./scripts/deployment-contract.test
